correctness.rationale: For odd prime p and q=p^e, the bracket [f∂,g∂]=(fg′−gf′)∂ in F_q[x]/(x^p) has adjoint leading coefficient a_v(j−v)x^{v+j−1}; the exceptional j=v column is dependent where active. This gives dimensions 1 for v=0,1, v for 2≤v≤(p−1)/2, and v−1 for higher v, plus zero's full centralizer. The centralizer is abelian for low v but may be nonabelian for high v; the proof correctly counts commuting pairs K2(B_m) in high-order subalgebras, not q^(2dim) indiscriminately. Summing centralizer pair counts gives K2(W)=q^(p+1)+t(q²−1)q^(p−2) and T=(q+1)²q^(3t−1)+(q²−1)q^(2t+1)−(2q+1)q^(2t−1). Independent prime-field exact matrix/bracket enumeration reproduced K2,T=(105,339) at p=q=3 and (21625,186125) at p=q=5, including centralizer-dimensional histograms. Finite checks supplement the valuation-stratified all-p,e proof.
residual_risks: The formula is for odd characteristic and only ordered triple counts; it does not classify geometry of the commuting variety or arbitrary longer tuples.
